core_problem_solved: To provide a standard, Type 4 JDBC driver for Java applications to connect and interact with MySQL databases.
key_features: Implements the Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) API
Enables connection pooling, statement execution, and result set processing
Handles MySQL-specific data types and features
era_and_niche: The official and essential JDBC driver for the world's most popular open-source relational database, used by millions of Java applications for decades under this coordinate.
reason_for_obsolescence: The specific Maven coordinate `mysql:mysql-connector-java` is now **legacy**. The project was rebranded and moved to a new coordinate: **`com.mysql:mysql-connector-j`**. All modern projects should use the new coordinate to receive the latest updates, bug fixes, and features.
